calibration_selection: held-out half of calibration firms; never validation/test outcomes

acceptance.scope: research criteria locked before fit; not product release gates

policy.firm_split: deterministic hash; 32 fit firms and 8 calibration firms per source train World
policy.sampling: equal per-firm quotas, then fill unused quota uniformly; no outcome stratification
policy.credit_note_only: fourth terminal cause; unsupported learned risk explicitly disclosed when no training examples
policy.writeoff: terminal under current synthetic contract; recoveries require a different event policy
policy.quantiles: paid CIF inverse within 365 days only; unreached quantiles are null with an explicit status
policy.cash_head: cumulative future VND receipts divided by as-of open amount; separate regression head
policy.old_holdouts: diagnostic comparisons only, already inspected during earlier development
policy.fresh_holdouts: new predeclared seeds under the same generator and scenario families; no tuning after outcomes
